capabilities: Record audio directly in Obsidian and auto-transcribe new recordings
Transcribe lecture audio locally with Whisper and write transcripts into linked notes
Generate titles, summaries, and key points with a local Ollama model
Combine several lectures into one set of study notes with a vocabulary table
Apply permanent transcription corrections and extra vocabulary
extras: Desktop-only (does not run on mobile). Setup downloads about 1.1 GB plus 2.6-5.2 GB for the summary model. The plugin runs external programs, which triggers Obsidian's directory flags for filesystem access and running programs; the README documents exactly which files, programs, and network hosts it touches. Not yet listed in the community plugin store; installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn audio recordings into transcripts and study notes, and cloud transcription services require accounts and uploading private recordings.

relations.evidence: Summaries are written by a second program called Ollama. It is free and also runs entirely on your computer.

summary: Local lecture recorder and transcriber that uses Whisper and a local Ollama model to write summaries, key points, and full transcripts into linked notes.
